question.text: A trader buys a put option on HDFC Bank with strike Rs. 1,600 at premium Rs. 55. At expiry, the stock is at Rs. 1,520. What is the profit?

explanation.text: The Logic: Put Profit = max(X - S, 0) - Premium Step-by-step: 1. X = 1,600, S = 1,520, P = 55 2. Payoff = max(1,600 - 1,520, 0) = Rs. 80 3. Profit = 80 - 55 = Rs. 25 The Trap: Don't forget to subtract premium. Payoff (80) minus premium (55) = profit (25). Cross-Exam Context: BEP = 1,600 - 55 = 1,545. Spot 1,520 < 1,545, confirming profit zone. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Put Profit = max(X - S, 0) - P = 80 - 55 = Rs. 25.
